craft_notes: Sthāyin: common-vs-distinction (v116's He-is seed: the yogin's care is the distinction). Rows: row 2 (He-is→carefulness). Close: carefulness (sāvadhānatā — the ONE yogin-qualifier: attention, not attainment). Rejected: 'awareness is shared' flat — kept common (sāmānya as universal property); 'discipline' — killed: carefulness kept (the word IS sāvadhāna).
